title: Swagger/OpenAPI spec import fails with 'invalid operationId' validation error
description: Trying to import an OpenAPI 3.0 spec for our new Inventory API into API Connect. The import keeps failing with a validation error saying two operationIds contain invalid characters. We generated this spec from our Spring Boot application.

worklogs.description: Validated the spec with ibm-openapi-validator CLI. Two operationIds contain forward slashes: 'inventory/list' and 'inventory/search'.
OpenAPI spec corrected: operationIds changed to 'inventoryList' and 'inventorySearch'.

comments.author: agent
comments.message: Hi, I ran the IBM OpenAPI validator against your spec and found the issue. Two operationId values contain forward slash characters ('inventory/list' and 'inventory/search'). The OpenAPI 3.0 spec requires operationIds to be unique strings with no special characters - the forward slash is not allowed. This was probably generated automatically from your Java method paths. You can fix this by changing the operationIds to camelCase equivalents like 'inventoryList' and 'inventorySearch'. Could you...

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Fixed both operationIds. Trying the import again now.

comments.author: customer
comments.message: Import succeeded. The Inventory API is now visible in the API Manager. Thank you for the quick diagnosis.

resolutionNote: Two operationId values in the OpenAPI spec contained forward slash characters which are not valid. Corrected to camelCase values ('inventoryList', 'inventorySearch'). Import succeeded after correction.
